I visited MAANEK AYURVEDA AND PANCHKARMA CLINIC for my mother’s knee pain after seeing all the fake glowing reviews on Google. Dr. Ankita Modi examined her pulse and navel, and confidently claimed her pain would be cured with just some kada and medicines. We trusted her.

But things turned shady quickly – she shifted focus to me, sweet-talked her way into selling me Shirodhara sessions for migraine, and falsely promised a “guaranteed cure” using “freshly prepared oil” each time. After paying ₹5240, she pressured me for the remaining ₹13,000, citing oil prep costs. Truth is – she reused the same oil every time. Zero results, just false claims and manipulation.

This clinic is a money trap. If you want genuine Ayurvedic care, go to Rishikesh – not here. Don't fall for this fraud. Worst decision ever.
